todo_line: - [ ] 001 Implement and test the actor-bearing custom-group removal use case at the Club boundary, including custom-group/actor/target validation, self/last-member removal, idempotency, and reuse of `GroupMemberRemoved` without club/role removal.

validation.evidence: Initial focused run exposed an isolated test-order issue: PublicApiTest selected alone had not loaded Memba.Membership before function_exported?/3, causing the pre-existing create_custom_group/1 assertion to report false; 115 tests, 1 failure, 108 excluded.

After explicitly ensuring Memba.Membership is loaded in PublicApiTest: 115 tests, 0 failures, 108 excluded. The selected tests cover the public actor-bearing API/command/router, member and outside-manager authorization, ordinary/inactive outsider rejection, typed and mismatched identities, custom/system group guards, self/final-member removal, exact self-retry idempotency, the existing actor-free GroupMemberRemoved fact, and unchanged aggregate club membership/role authority.

15 tests, 0 failures. Admission and removal dispatch paths pass together; a real removal emits only GroupMemberRemoved, deactivates the group-membership projection, permits an outside Admin without joining, and preserves the removed Admin target's active club membership, Admin role, and club.manage_members permission.
No whitespace errors in the packet diff.

notes: Verified the carried task-001 candidate: Membership.remove_custom_group_member/1 and /2 build a dedicated actor-bearing command routed by club_id to Membership.Club, while trusted actor-free RemoveGroupMember remains separate. Club current event-sourced state validates actor, target, group, and typed identities; authorizes current custom-group members or active club.manage_members holders; supports self/final-member removal and an event-free self retry after departure; rejects ordinary/inactive outsiders and system groups; and emits only the existing GroupMemberRemoved fact without changing club membership or roles. The only new correction makes the focused PublicApiTest independent of incidental module load order. todo.md, acceptance features, Messaging cleanup, UI, and full-suite ownership were left untouched.
